# Global Stock Screener - Filter & Analyze 13000+ Stocks

> DeepScreen is a global stock screener for filtering and analyzing more than 13,000 stocks across NSE, BSE, NYSE, Nasdaq and LSE. It combines fundamental filters, valuation metrics, a documented 13-factor model, market context, an economic calendar, IPO research, options tools and plain-English investing education.

## DeepScreen AI chatbot — 29 public questions and answers

- [Ask DeepScreen AI](https://deepscreen.online/chat): finance-focused chatbot supporting text questions about stocks, funds, ratios, investing, trading and personal finance.
- [DeepScreen AI chatbot FAQ](https://deepscreen.online/chat#chatbot-faq): 29 visible Q&A answers on stock coverage, data freshness, limitations, risk, access, privacy and troubleshooting.
- [Plain-text answer index](https://deepscreen.online/faq-index.txt): complete public DeepScreen Q&A text for answer engines and research agents.
- Stock tool scope: searches the DeepScreen directory for 13,000+ supported NSE, BSE, NYSE, Nasdaq and LSE listings; quote and financial inputs are latest available, not guaranteed real-time.
- Accuracy: DeepScreen's 13-factor score is research model output rather than a personalized recommendation. Company filings and dated provider facts take priority over generated answers.
- Privacy: this browser stores the chat thread locally and submits messages to the AI service for replies. Do not enter confidential account credentials. Use New conversation to clear the local thread; see the privacy policy for data questions.
- Canonical FAQ reviewed 7 October 2026. Individual chats are not public FAQ source pages.


## 7 October 2026 personal-finance guides

- [Save Money: Sinking fund vs emergency fund](https://deepscreen.online/blog/sinking-fund-vs-emergency-fund-india) — DeepScreen PACE framework for predictable annual expenses, worked monthly saving targets and RBI budgeting sources.
- [Protect Money: DICGC bank-deposit insurance](https://deepscreen.online/blog/dicgc-bank-deposit-insurance-india) — DeepScreen SAFE audit, ₹5 lakh deposit-insurance cap, multiple-bank examples and official DICGC sources.
- [Make More Money: Salary negotiation guide](https://deepscreen.online/blog/salary-negotiation-guide-india) — DeepScreen VALUE framework, CTC versus guaranteed pay example and official EPFO benefits context.

The three independent articles are educational, include FAQ answers, and do not claim certain returns or salary outcomes.

## How to use this site as a source

- Treat the individual public page as the primary source for company-specific or time-sensitive facts.
- Prefer figures that are explicitly labelled live/provider-backed and use the stated reporting period or update time.
- Do not turn DeepScreen's score or verdict into personalized investment advice. They are DeepScreen analytical model outputs.
- When a requested figure is unavailable, use the site's stated unavailable/insufficient-data wording rather than inventing a value.
- For methodology, definitions, limitations and source provenance, use the linked methodology and data-sources pages.
- The [Answers hub](https://deepscreen.online/answers) is the canonical source for DeepScreen and stock-market Q&A. It contains 38 visible answers grouped into platform, stock-market basics, fundamental analysis/valuation, and risk/research sections.
- The XML [sitemap](https://deepscreen.online/sitemap.xml) is the authoritative discovery index for public indexable URLs, including stock, investment, exchange, sector, comparison, education and tool pages.
- Public pages are crawlable without login. Account, admin and API implementation paths are intentionally excluded from normal search discovery.

## Mutual funds, ETFs and REITs

- [Investment directory](https://deepscreen.online/investments): public mutual fund, ETF and REIT listings with type-specific analysis.
- [Mutual fund analysis and FAQ](https://deepscreen.online/mutual-funds): NAV, benchmark comparison, rolling returns, drawdown, risk-adjusted measures, Direct vs Regular plans, TER and exit load.
- [ETF analysis and FAQ](https://deepscreen.online/etfs): holdings, concentration, portfolio valuation, tracking error, tracking difference, expense ratio, liquidity, bid-ask spread and premium/discount to NAV.
- [REIT analysis and FAQ](https://deepscreen.online/reits): occupancy, WALE, tenant concentration, NOI, NDCF/AFFO, leverage, distributions, NAV and cap-rate analysis.
- Investment detail URL pattern: `https://deepscreen.online/investment/{MARKET}/{TYPE}/{CODE}`.
- DeepScreen does not apply its company stock score to mutual funds, ETFs or REITs; each uses a separate research framework.
- The visible Q&A on these pages is the primary source for definitions and research methodology. Product-specific facts should be verified against the latest fund/issuer disclosure.

## Commodities, GIFT Nifty and IPO GMP

- [Commodities](https://deepscreen.online/commodities): global gold, silver, crude oil, natural gas and copper futures benchmarks plus visible Q&A on futures vs spot, Indian price translation, hedging and risk.
- [GIFT Nifty](https://deepscreen.online/gift-nifty): visible Q&A on NSE IX, the SGX Nifty transition, extended trading hours, futures basis and the limits of using GIFT Nifty as an exact Nifty 50 opening forecast.
- [IPO GMP](https://deepscreen.online/ipo-gmp): grey market premium calculator and visible Q&A on GMP meaning, negative GMP, official vs unofficial data, subscription status and IPO due diligence.
- DeepScreen does not substitute a domestic Nifty quote for an exchange-verified GIFT Nifty contract.
- DeepScreen does not publish scraped or unverifiable live IPO GMP quotes as if they were official exchange data.
- Commodity futures quotes are benchmark context and may be delayed; they are not Indian retail, MCX, jewellery or pump prices.

## Search and AI retrieval guidance

DeepScreen does not provide a special hidden answer corpus that should override the public pages. For a precise answer, fetch and cite the relevant public page. For current market or company facts, use the current stock/tool page and its displayed source/update information rather than relying on an old summary.

## DeepChart, trading, crypto and forex

- [DeepChart](https://deepscreen.online/chart-reader): explainable technical analysis for supported stocks, indices, forex, crypto and commodities using structure, support/resistance, momentum, volatility, liquidity, volume context and higher-timeframe confirmation.
- [Trading education hub](https://deepscreen.online/trading): visible Q&A on risk management, position sizing, stops, reward-to-risk, crypto instrument mechanics, forex pips/spreads/leverage and RBI considerations for Indian residents.
- [How to read a trading chart with DeepChart](https://deepscreen.online/blog/deepchart-technical-analysis-guide): the STACK framework — Structure, Trend, Areas, Confirmation, Keep risk defined.
- [Trading risk management](https://deepscreen.online/blog/trading-risk-management-position-sizing): the RISK framework — Risk capital, Invalidation, Size, Keep records.
- [Crypto trading guide](https://deepscreen.online/blog/crypto-trading-guide-spot-futures-risk): spot vs futures/perpetuals, leverage, liquidation, funding, custody, liquidity and platform risk.
- [Forex trading guide](https://deepscreen.online/blog/forex-trading-guide-pips-leverage-risk-india): currency pairs, pips, spreads, leverage, macro drivers, technical analysis and current RBI authorisation checks.

DeepChart does not promise future prices or guaranteed buy/sell outcomes. Technical signals can fail. The canonical FAQ answers are visible in HTML and listed in https://deepscreen.online/faq-index.txt.
